meta.name: Cadillac Man
meta.description: Joe's a car salesman with a problem—he has two days to sell 12 cars or he loses his job. This would be a difficult task at the best of times but Joe has to contend with his girlfriends (he's two-timing), a missing teenage daughter and an ex-wife.
meta.slogan: If you can't trust a car salesman who can you trust?
